text: Corner scale: 3px for thin bars (progress), 6-8px for small chips, labels, step markers and tooltips, 10px for buttons, inputs, nav items and list rows, 12-14px for cards and panels, 16-18px for page frames and the bookshelf case. Themes may vary these values but never use pill (fully rounded) or square corners on interface elements; book spines keep physical book corners.
rationale: Turns the owner's corner rule into token values the theme contract can carry
